stem:
The diagram shows Arjun's pinhole camera. He points the tiny hole at a lit candle and looks at the tracing-paper screen at the back.

What should appear on the screen?

options.text: An upside-down image of the candle, also reversed left to right.
An upright image of the candle, reversed left to right.
A bright circular patch matching the round shape of the pinhole, not an image of the candle.
An upside-down image of the candle even if the pinhole faces away from the candle.

teacher.key_rationale: Rays from the candle cross at the tiny hole and hit the screen, so the image is inverted top-bottom and left-right.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote lens-ray figure into a pinhole camera aimed at a candle.
